parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the response format returned by the server. `application/x-ndjson` can be used for streaming progress responses.

async.description: When set to true, the interface immediately returns task_id, which can then be used to query the results through the Tasks API.

model.description: HappyHorse model name. Different actions only support the corresponding model family.

ratio.description: Output video aspect ratio. Text-to-video and reference image-to-video support this parameter; the first frame image-to-video will follow the aspect ratio of the first frame image.

action.description: Operation types. `generate` is for generating video from text, `image_to_video` is for generating video from the first frame image, `reference_to_video` is for generating video from reference images, and `video_edit` is for video editing based on video and reference images.

prompt.example: A cinematic white horse lifts its head, the mane moves gently in the sunrise wind, slow camera push in, warm film lighting
prompt.description: Text prompt words. Text-to-video, reference image to video, and video editing scenarios are required.

duration.description: Output video duration (seconds), value range 3–15. The output duration of `video_edit` is determined by the input video.

image_url.description: The input image URL for the first frame of the video. Only used by `image_to_video`.

video_url.description: URL of the video to be edited. For `video_edit` use only.

watermark.description: Whether to add the HappyHorse watermark. Default is off.

image_urls.description: Reference image URL array. `reference_to_video` supports 1–9 images, `video_edit` supports 0–5 images.

callback_url.description: Asynchronous callback address. After setting, the interface will immediately return task_id, and after the task is completed, the result will be POSTed to this address.

audio_setting.description: Audio strategy for video editing. `auto` is determined by the model, `origin` retains the original audio of the input video.
